title: Dense Molecular Gas Properties of the Central Kiloparsec of Nearby Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxies Constrained by ALMA Three Transition-line Observations
question: What are the physical and chemical properties (H2 volume density, kinetic temperature, and HCN-to-HCO+ abundance ratio) of nuclear dense molecular gas in the central 1–2 kpc of nearby (U)LIRGs with and without luminous AGN signatures?

data.angular_resolution: 0.12'' x 0.09'' to 1.8'' x 1.1'' native; matched to circular beams of 0.84'' to 3.1'' (1–2 kpc)

evidence.quote: Col.(5)–(8): f$_{12}$, f$_{25}$, f$_{60}$, and f$_{100}$ are *IRAS* fluxes at 12 $\mu$m, 25 $\mu$m, 60 $\mu$m, and 100 $\mu$m, obtained from (cite: kim98), (cite: san03), or the IRAS Faint Source Catalog (FSC).

external_data.citation: (cite: kim98), (cite: san03), IRAS Faint Source Catalog (FSC)

what.value: Herschel photometric data at 250, 350, and 500 um

evidence.loc: Continuum Flux Density Measured with 1–2 kpc Beam
evidence.quote: For certain fractions of the observed ULIRGs, the photometric data at 250 $\mu$m, 350 $\mu$m, and 500 $\mu$m taken with the Herschel Space Observatory are available (cite: cle18).

what.value: Infrared spectroscopically estimated bolometric contribution of AGNs

evidence.quote: Col.(11): Infrared spectroscopically estimated bolometric contribution of AGNs in % by (cite: nar10) for all ULIRGs and by (cite: per15) for the LIRG NGC 1614.

recipe.goal: Match beam sizes of continuum-subtracted cubes and continuum images across transitions
recipe.method: Convolve continuum-subtracted data cubes and continuum maps to a common circular beam size (1, 1.5, 1.6, or 2 kpc) for each target using CASA task imsmooth
key_parameters: Adopted circular beam sizes: 3.1'' (1 kpc) for NGC 1614; 1.1'' (1.6 kpc) for IRAS 06035-7102; 0.9'' (1 kpc) for IRAS 08572+3915; 1.1'' (1.5 kpc) for IRAS 12112+0305; 0.86'' (2 kpc) for IRAS 12127-1412; 0.84'' (2 kpc) for IRAS 13509+0442; 1.4'' (1.5 kpc) for IRAS 15250+3609; 0.85'' (1 kpc) for Superantennae; 1.2'' (1 kpc) for IRAS 20551-4250; 1.0'' (1.5 kpc) for IRAS 22491-1808
assumptions: For transitions where the native beam or major axis is larger than the adopted beam, the bulk of the J=3-2 and J=4-3 flux originates from the nuclear region within the adopted beam

recipe.goal: Extract nuclear spectra, measure continuum flux densities, and fit Gaussian line profiles to derive line fluxes and ratios
recipe.method: Extract 1–2 kpc beam spectra and continuum peak fluxes at the continuum peak position; fit single or double Gaussian profiles to molecular emission lines to derive velocity-integrated fluxes and line ratios
key_parameters: Single Gaussian fit for all lines except HCN and HCO+ in IRAS 12112+0305 NE (double Gaussian fit)
assumptions: Cosmological parameters H_0 = 71 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_M = 0.27, Omega_Lambda = 0.73

recipe.goal: Compare observed HCN-to-HCO+ flux ratios with RADEX non-LTE model grids
recipe.method: Calculate non-LTE emission line flux ratios using RADEX via pyradex over a grid of H2 density and kinetic temperature and compare in 3D ratio space (J=2-1, J=3-2, J=4-3)
assumptions: Static and spherically symmetric homogeneous medium, background temperature = 2.73 K, H2 as only collision partner, HNC excluded

recipe.goal: Constrain H2 gas density and kinetic temperature via least-squares fitting of high-J to low-J line ratios
recipe.method: Fit four observed high-J to low-J flux ratios (J=3-2/J=2-1 and J=4-3/J=2-1 of HCN and HCO+) with RADEX models using Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm in lmfit, optionally preceded by L-BFGS-B optimization of flux calibration scaling factors
key_parameters: Grid of log n_H2 from 2 to 6 and log T_kin from 1 to 3; fiducial N_HCO+ = 1 x 10^16 cm^-2 and [HCN]/[HCO+] = 3; line widths Delta v from Table 3 (200 to 800 km s^-1)
assumptions: Absolute flux calibration uncertainty scaling up to 5% for Band 5 and 10% for Bands 6 and 7 (doubled for Cycle 0)

recipe.goal: Perform Bayesian MCMC analysis with all model and scaling parameters free for six bright sources
recipe.method: Simultaneously fit five independent emission line flux ratios using RADEX and MCMC sampling via emcee in lmfit with all parameters free
key_parameters: 100 walkers, chain length = 100 * tau steps, burn-in = 5 * tau steps, thinning = 0.5 * tau steps, 19,000 effective samples
assumptions: Flat priors with bounds: log(n_H2/cm^-3) in [2, 6], log(T_kin/K) in [1, 3], log(N_HCO+/cm^-2) in [14, 17], [HCN]/[HCO+] in [0.1, 10], J21a scaling in [0.95, 1.05], J32a scaling in [0.9, 1.1], J43a scaling in [0.9, 1.1]

answer_key.quantity: NGC 1614 nuclear log n_H2 (fiducial LM fit)
NGC 1614 nuclear log T_kin (fiducial LM fit)

score_reason: All measured line fluxes, line widths, continuum frequencies, beam sizes, and RADEX/MCMC priors and settings are tabulated in full detail; only the raw-to-cube imaging parameters are deferred to earlier papers.
rediscovery_reason: All six ALMA project codes are public in the archive, the complete intermediate tables of integrated fluxes and ratios are provided, and the RADEX/lmfit/emcee modeling recipe is fully specified with explicit parameter bounds and convergence criteria.
